caseNameFull: Bellaskus v. Crossman, Officer in Charge, U. S. Immigration & Naturalization Service
attorneys: Petitioner submitted on brief pro se., Philip R. Monahan argued the cause for respondent., With him on the brief were Solicitor General Perlman and Robert S. Erdahl.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam:

Upon suggestion of the Solicitor General and consideration of the record, the judgment of the Court of Appeals is reversed and the cause is remanded to the District Court with directions to vacate its order discharging the rule to show cause and dismissing the petition for a writ of habeas corpus.

Philip R. Monahan argued the cause for respondent. With him on the brief were Solicitor General Perlman and Robert S. Erdahl.
